propositions: Cloud's AcliClient.update_issue must route empty-assignee values (None and empty string) to unassign_issue instead of forwarding them to ACLI as --assignee flags.
When update_issue is called with assignee='' or assignee=None and no other editable fields, no workitem edit subprocess should be spawned.

When update_issue is called with assignee='' and other editable fields (e.g. summary), unassign_issue must be called once AND a workitem edit argv must be emitted with the other fields but no --assignee flag.
Non-empty assignee values must bypass the unassign path and follow the validate-then-edit path with --assignee present in the argv.
Test coverage must be positive (asserting correct behavior) rather than negative, to prevent regression if empty-assignee handling is removed.
